prompt_discipline_BLOCKING: the authorship prompt contains ONLY: the problem definition (committed bytes), the class semantics in natural engineering language (this contract, verbatim), the output JSON schema, and a no-meta-comment instruction

the prompt NEVER contains: the intervention_gate.py source, any gate regex or threshold constant, the gate check names, prior sweep results, the CLEAN_CLASSES token list, or any hint about what the gates detect

the class semantics are phrased as ENGINEERING failure modes of candidate proposals (e.g. 'a proposal that only adds monitoring'), never as instrument-covering instructions (e.g. never 'make the not_an_intervention regex fire')
the coder does NOT edit, curate, filter, or regenerate any specimen text; a specimen that fails schema parsing is DISCARDED with a typed count (never hand-repaired into shape)
authorship_independence_design.provenance_per_specimen: model id, the verbatim prompt, wall, timestamp, and the raw generation are committed alongside the specimens file so the auditor can re-derive every row

defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.monitor_only_proposal: SEED class: the proposal's entire content is to monitor, measure, study, trend, or analyze the system — no design change to the artifact itself
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.function_removal: SEED class: the proposal removes or weakens a function the problem's constraint mandates — lowers a mandated floor, raises a mandated ceiling, narrows a mandated operating range, or eliminates a mandated element
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.constraint_restatement: SEED class: the proposal's mechanism is a paraphrase of the requirement itself — the constraint text dressed as the invention, with no mechanism of its own
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.off_domain_anchor: SEED class: the proposal anchors its evidence or mechanism to a mismatched technical domain with no stated shared mechanism linking it to the problem
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.legit_intervention: CLEAN CONTROL class (the sweep's false-kill metric): a genuine engineering intervention that plausibly satisfies the constraint and does not commit any seeded class above
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.counts_default: 8 per SEED class x 4 classes = 32 seeded + 16 clean controls = 48 specimens (owner-adjustable at contract review; per-instrument denominators at n>=8 give 0.125 rate resolution)
defect_class_taxonomy_pre_registered.problem_assignment_deterministic: specimens are assigned to committed problem ids by strided round-robin over the sorted eval/problems.json list (no cherry-picking; the assignment is reproducible from this contract alone)

types: str or null (the stated mechanism when the class calls for one)
specimen_schema.denylist_compliance: no field name contains key/rubric/answer/expected/gold/label/truthy/verdict (word-level, the sweep's enforced NEVER-READ denylist); the authorship prompt enforces exactly these four keys
specimen_schema.sweep_consumption: intervention -> the text under judgment; problem_id -> the constraint + domain context for the measurable checks; mechanism -> the restates-check third argument; defect_class -> the per-class aggregates and the per-instrument denominators

eval/seeded_specimens_v1.sha256 — the FULL 64-hex sha256 of the exact file bytes
placement_plan.integrity_mode: FULL-HASH (64-hex) — the queue runner auto-selects full-match mode at len==64, which the sweep itself documents as STRONGER than the owner-prefix mode (audit G: prefix < full hash)

placement_plan.sweep_invocation: placement makes scripts/r7_queue_runner.py build_plan() schedule the seeded item automatically; equivalently direct: python3 scripts/r6_seeded_sweep.py --specimens eval/seeded_specimens_v1.json --expected-selection-sha256 $(cat eval/seeded_specimens_v1.sha256) --output-dir ENGINE_RUNS/seeded_r12

XXVII). The owner seals in the same turn as the placement review or a later one — the sweep emits PENDING_OWNER_SEAL until then
